prompt: A photograph from a lens fixed at the top of a lamp post, looking down steeply at a suburban street in flat overcast daylight. Brandon jogs along the pavement, small and foreshortened from above, in a loose grey tracksuit and with an easy, upright stride, his face turned forward and calm. In the road beside him a white ambulance with a blank side panel rolls slowly past, and Sophie sits in the passenger window looking out at him with her brows drawn together and her mouth closed. Wet tarmac, a postbox and parked cars give washed-out, compressed colour. Thanks.
